snippet.title: Dreamcast Longplay - Cannon Spike
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played By: RickyC

A couple of runs played on very easy as this game can get difficult as well as i'm pretty terrible at games like this. The run with Charlie is shown 2nd but that is my first run I did to get used to the controls which is why I may appear to play worse as the video goes on.

 This video is really just to test recording from a dreamcast emulator for later use. -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
